faqs.a:
Public parks within the city, unless otherwise closed as provided in section 66-8,
               shall be open daily to the public from daylight until 11:00 p.m., and no person, not
               an employee of the city or the North Jeffco Metropolitan Recreation and Park District,
               in his official capacity, shall enter or remain in or within the boundaries of such
               facilities at any other time; provided, however, the board of directors of the North
               Jeffco Metropolitan Recreation and Park District may issue permits extending or limiting
               the time specified in this section for special events, provided prior notification
               is given to the police department.
(Code 1960, § 17-32; Code 1981, § 22-13)
